product_launches.description: Omnea launched its MCP (Model Context Protocol) Server, allowing procurement teams to access and act on centralized supplier data directly from AI assistants such as Claude, ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, Cohere North, and Cursor.

overview_description.description: Omnea offers a procurement orchestration platform that streamlines source-to-pay workflows. It enables organizations to centralize supplier data, renewals, approvals, and purchase order automation, while embedding risk management and sourcing tools. Omnea provides modules for intelligent intake (request management), a supplier portal for due diligence, and no-code workflow building to define processes and approvals. Omnea’s reporting suite delivers visibility into spend, supplier performance, and compliance, and AI features assist with RFx generation, policy-aligned document parsing, and risk assessments. The platform integrates with finance and legal systems to reduce manual effort, maintain governance, and ensure consistent supplier evaluation.

product.name: Omnea Agentic Operating System for Procurement
product.description: A procurement orchestration platform that connects procurement systems, automates source-to-pay workflows, and centralizes supplier, request, approval, risk, and spend data.

product.name: Omnea AI
product.description: Embedded AI capabilities that automate procurement tasks, guide requests, summarize information, generate assessments, and answer questions about supplier data.

product.name: Intake and Guided Buying
product.description: A centralized request experience that captures purchasing needs, recommends compliant buying routes, and routes requests to the appropriate stakeholders and workflows.

product.name: Workflow Builder and Approval Workflows
product.description: A no-code workflow and approval system for automating procurement processes, stakeholder routing, handoffs, reminders, and auditable decisions.

product.name: Third-Party Risk Management
product.description: A procurement-integrated system for assessing, recording, monitoring, and mitigating risks associated with suppliers and other third parties.

product.name: Supplier Management
product.description: A centralized supplier management capability for onboarding vendors, maintaining supplier records, collecting information, and coordinating supplier lifecycle activities.
